newsitem.title: USA: Donnelly withdraws planned share offering.
newsitem.headline: Donnelly withdraws planned share offering.

text.p: Donnelly Corp on Monday said it filed an application with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission to withdraw its planned offering of 1.5 million shares of Class A common stock.
Donnelly spokesman Bill Jellison there were several reasons for the decision, including the price of the company's stock and a possible expansion of Donnelly's optics unit.
Donnelly will hold a conference call with analysts on Tuesday morning to explain its decision further, he said.
Shares of Donnelly, which supplies automotive glass, closed down 1/8 at 16-7/8, compared with a 52-week high of 20 and a 52-week low of 11-3/4.
